name: Olive Pizza
title: About Olive Pizza Restaurant
description: Olive Pizza is Rajnandgaon's premier 100% Pure Vegetarian artisan woodfired pizzeria, serving fresh handcrafted dough, Italian stone-oven baked crusts, rich mozzarella, and authentic herbs. Our kitchen is 100% strictly pure veg (🌱) and prepares special Jain options (no onion, no garlic) on request.
